profile.headline: Connecting Technology, Business, and People | Architect | Builder | Engineer
profile.summary:
I help organizations navigate technology transitions.

Over the course of my career, I have worked across enterprise software, distributed systems, cloud computing, and AI, helping organizations translate emerging technologies into real-world business outcomes.

My experience spans engineering, architecture, consulting, product incubation, and executive engagement. I have led enterprise-scale initiatives across industries including aviation, automotive, finance, healthcare, manufacturing, and the public sector, working with organizations throughout APAC, EMEA, and North America.

One of the roles I have enjoyed most is serving as the bridge between product engineering teams and enterprise customers, translating business challenges into technical solutions while bringing customer insights back into product strategy.

Today, my interests are centered around Agentic AI, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, and the future of software engineering.

I believe meaningful innovation happens when technology, business objectives, and people move in the same direction.

While technologies continue to evolve, one thing has remained constant:

I enjoy building.

At heart, I remain an engineer.
